facts.fact: The sector regulator ARCEP's register of laws lists Loi N°009/PR/2015 on Cybersecurity and the Fight against Cybercrime among Chad's laws; the page gives no other date, so 2015 is the number's year.
facts.system: Loi N°009/PR/2015 portant sur la Cybersécurité et la Lutte Contre la Cybercriminalité

note: Register lists the law by title only; no use of it is stated.
